senses.gloss: f. (נָעֵם; v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. II, p. 569 sq.) ostrich.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:14">Kel. XVII, 14</cite> <he>ביצת נ׳ המצופה</he> the glazed shell of an ostrich egg; Tosef.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:14">ib.</cite>, <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:6">B. Mets. VII, 6</cite>.
Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵈ את בת היענה זו ביצת נ׳ ‘the child of a yaʿănah’ (Lev. XI, 16), this intimates that the egg of an ostrich (and of all other unclean birds) is forbidden; a. e.—Pl. נָעֳמִיּוֹת.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:8">Tosef. Sabb. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:8">XV</cite>), 8; <cite ref="Shabbat 128a:4">Sabb. 128ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שהוא מאכל לנ׳</he> because glass pieces are given to ostriches to swallow.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:4:10">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> top. Midr. Sam. ch. XVIII; a. e.
